headword: {猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい

definitions.gloss: even want to borrow a cat's paws; desperately busy
definitions.explanation: So extremely busy that one would accept any help available, even from a cat (whose paws are useless for work). Describes a state of being overwhelmingly short-handed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧。
examples.english: At year-end, we're so busy we'd even borrow a cat's paws.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人手|ひとで}→人手：25438_hitode⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{足|た}りなくて→足りる：01209_tariru⟧、{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: We're so short-staffed that we'd take any help we can get.

examples.japanese: ⟦イベント→イベント：09594_ibento⟧⟦{前日|ぜんじつ}→前日：03108_zenjitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{追|お}われた→追う：02016_ou⟧。
examples.english: The day before the event, we were so overwhelmed with preparations that any help would've been welcome.

notes:
USAGE: This expression vividly describes extreme busyness or being desperately short-handed. The humor comes from the absurdity of wanting help from a cat, whose paws are clearly useless for human tasks.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦ほど→程：01724_hodo⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧ (so busy one would even borrow a cat's paws)
・{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧ (a desperately short-handed situation)
・{猫|ねこ}の{手|て}も{借|か}りたい⟦ぐらい→ぐらい：02900_gurai⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧ (we're so busy that...)

CULTURAL NOTE: This expression reflects the Japanese work culture where being extremely busy is common, especially during certain seasons like ⟦{年末|ねんまつ}→年末：17688_nenmatsu⟧ (year-end), ⟦{決算期|けっさんき}→決算期：29384_kessanki⟧ (fiscal closing), or before major events.

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・⟦てんてこ{舞|ま}い→てんてこ舞い：29385_tentekomai⟧ (frantically busy)
・⟦{目|め}が{回|まわ}る→目が回る：19927_megamawaru⟧ (so busy one's head spins)
